description.short: Ecommerce conversion, checkout, error and experiment insights from Noibu
description.full:
Built for ecommerce, Noibu is a continuous improvement engine for your store. Connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to Noibu’s six AI agents (Bug Resolution, Performance, ROAS, CRO, ADA, and A/B Testing) and to the marketing, support, and commerce platforms that put insight into motion. Go beyond analysis: uncover growth opportunities, find what’s costing you revenue, and get prioritized recommendations, drafted changes, and test ideas. Then take action across your stack and build workflows to automate work end-to-end. Requires a Noibu account.

Getting started with Noibu

New to Noibu? Start a free trial: https://www.noibu.com/free-trial?utm_source=microsoft-copilot&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=copilot-app-listing&utm_content=app-description.
Set up Noibu in Microsoft 365 Copilot: help.noibu.com/articles/5532087644-noibu-for-ms365-copilot
Help center and documentation: help.noibu.com
Contact support: support@noibu.com
Learn more about Noibu: noibu.com
